name: Preset Cloud
description: Preset Cloud is a powerful platform for data exploration and visualization, enabling users to create interactive dashboards and gain insights from their data effortlessly.

events.d: Retrieve all teams in the connected Preset Cloud account.
Retrieve the members of a Preset Cloud team.
Remove a specified user from a Preset Cloud team. Returns success data or a clear error if removal is blocked (e.g., last admin, already removed, or assigned via a group).
